text: Education Objectives The educational aim of Petroleum Engineering specialty is to cultivate students with advanced technology and engineering knowledge. Students also be engaged in petroleum engineering design, operation and construction, production and management, scientific development and applied research Main Courses Technological Economics, Oil and Gas Development Geology, Engineering Mechanics, Computer Programming, Fluid Mechanics, Permeation Fluid Mechanics, Drilling Engineering, Oil Extraction, Petroleum Reservoir Engineering, Oilfield Chemistry, Drilling New Technology, etc. Internship Practice, course design, surveying and mapping practice, graduation practice, graduation design. Degree Awarded Bachelor Degree of Engineering. Career Graduates can be comprehensive talents to make research; teaching or management related this field in the scientific institute, university or enterprise etc.
